tianshu.name: tianshu-research
tianshu.description: Click-to-install OA paper search (arXiv/OpenAlex), Evidence Ledger, journal palettes, plus research screening skill. Not an auto-paper writer.

tools.name: research_query
tools.description: Read-only scholarly query gateway for paper search and metadata resolution across arXiv and OpenAlex.

tools.name: research_evidence
tools.description: Structured scientific evidence ledger gateway. Manage sources, exact-locator evidence, and claims in the research workspace.

tools.name: journal_palette
tools.description: Journal figure hex palettes (100 curated publication palettes for Python). id 1–100, role, or ColorBrewer name.

tools.name: research_status
tools.description: Optional diagnostic tool to inspect research workspace status, evidence ledger statistics, and palettes.
